summary:
I built and iterated on Summit, a SaaS crypto algo trading platform with AI/neural network components, adding notification infrastructure, wallet group features, and prediction research while performing large-scale refactoring and release management. I developed firmware for USB HID emulation on ESP32-S3, progressing through multiple versions with features like fire-and-forget event emitting and matrix variants, and built a Windows input filter/injection driver from scratch with push-style event delivery and integration testing.

In parallel, I conducted extensive research on crypto price prediction models, testing cross-pair generalization and drift detection, and developed an Android TTS app with multiple engine support. I built the OzWil LLM-powered phone assistant with sub-agent delegation, and created the JAW agentic worker framework with Telegram integration and memory management. I maintained the intag2 Windows file-tagging utility, worked on poker CV analysis, trading strategies for Freqtrade, and various e-ink firmware projects.

Earlier in the window, I developed an autonomous coding agent (auto-claude), a Telegram multi-bot for Freqtrade monitoring, and a personal assistant bot, along with a Flutter app for trading bot monitoring.

items.title: Summit platform development
items.description: Built notification infrastructure, wallet group features, and prediction research for the Summit crypto algo trading platform; performed large-scale refactoring and release management.

items.title: Crypto prediction model research
items.description: Conducted research on crypto price prediction models: tested cross-pair generalization, drift detection, and meta-logreg filtering; maintained live paper trading.

items.title: JAW agentic worker
items.description: Built the JAW agentic worker: implemented Telegram threading, memory management, workflow presets, and a graphical control room.

items.title: intag2 maintenance
items.description: Fixed metadata write errors, added Vorbis comment support for audio files, and improved CI pipeline for the Windows Explorer file-tagging utility.

items.title: Freqtrade strategy development
items.description: Developed new trading strategies: pack-relative reversion and BTC-relative-strength variants with backtesting results.

items.title: CV generation tool enhancements
items.description: Enhanced the personal CV generation tool: added skills section, improved heatmap and timeline rendering, and refined LLM prompts.

items.title: EwoDip strategy variants
items.description: Developed EwoDip15m trading strategy variants with DCA and trend regime guards.

items.title: jolt automation tool
items.description: Built the jolt automation tool: implemented scenario engine with typed actions, conditions, and stateless themes.

items.title: USB HID firmware v13
items.description: Developed firmware for USB HID emulation on ESP32-S3: added fire-and-forget event emitting, 8x8 matrix variant, and platformio support.

items.title: Windows input driver
items.description: Built a Windows input filter/injection driver: implemented push-style event delivery, integration test runner, and per-event blocking.

items.title: intag2 encoding fix
items.description: Fixed desktop.ini encoding for non-ASCII characters in the file-tagging utility.

items.title: Android TTS app
items.description: Developed Android TTS app: integrated multiple TTS engines, added pitch control, and improved text normalization.

items.title: CV tool project cards

items.title: MEMU3 computer vision

items.title: biscuit e-ink firmware

items.title: Firmware variant and fixes

items.title: papyrix firmware features

items.title: Clash.Meta API exposure

items.title: Firmware v12/v13 release

items.title: OzWil LLM app

items.title: OzWil API backend

items.title: Map app and FB2 support

items.title: Blackboard launcher
